about_the_game:
Command a group of space settlers trying to establish a base on a remote world.

Build your base, mine resources, grow food, research technologies, survive disasters, and experience what near-future humans might be up against.

Planetbase 2 features a unique blend of real-time strategy, city building and survival gameplay. You design and automate your base at a high level as much as possible, but when required, you can control individual people, robots or vehicles.

Colonize the Solar System

Colonize Mars and the worlds beyond. Each location posing its own unique and increasingly difficult challenge.

Mine and Manufacture

Make use of in-situ resources in order to build a self sustaining colony. Harvest regolith, mine metals, establish manufacturing industries and do whatever it takes for your colony to survive and thrive.

Produce Food

Cultivate vegetables in giant greenhouses, synthesize meat in the lab, produce food in any way possible. Keep your people alive and achieve self sufficiency.

Harness the power of Nature

Collect energy from whatever sources are available in each world. Develop the systems required to harvest and store energy from The Sun, Wind, Nuclear and more.

Withstand Planetary Hazards

Encounter planet specific natural disasters like Solar Flares, Sandstorms, Meteors, Dust Devils and more.

Research

Acquire technologies that will alter gameplay in a meaningful way and make it possible for your base to develop from a small outpost to a vibrant colony.

Construct Vehicles and Robots

Manufacture or import vehicles and robots that will aid with the hardest tasks in the settlement and increase your chances of survival.

Take Control

Automated systems will allow you to manage your colony without micromanagement most of the time. However, when the need arises, you will be able to give specific commands to individuals, so they do what you need them to.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or above (64 bit)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible with support for Shader Model 5.0 and 1GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or above (64 bit)
  • Processor: Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD or NVIDIA card
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Colonize the Solar System. Command a group of near-future humans trying to establish a base on Mars and beyond. Grow food, mine resources, manufacture goods and face the challenges these unforgiving worlds will throw at you.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
